title: UFOs Filmed From a Passenger Plane at 40,000 Feet
excerpt: A Virginia resident filmed mysterious UFOs from aboard a passenger plane at an altitude of 40,000 feet, raising questions about what was flying at that altitude
content:
A short but rather bizarre video circulating online has drawn attention to an unusual sighting high above the ground. The video belongs to Charles Roark of Martinsville, Virginia. According to the post, he captured several unidentified objects while flying on a passenger jet.

The reported altitude makes this sighting particularly intriguing. The plane was reportedly flying at approximately 40,000 feet (over 12,000 kilometers), well above the landscapes and buildings typically used as reference points when filming objects in the sky.

The 28-second video was published on TikTok under the account @mr.herniated on November 19, 2026. The post attributes the footage to Charles Roark who reportedly filmed several unidentified objects while aboard a passenger aircraft.

The main question is simple: what exactly was moving in the sky at such an altitude? Available information does not allow us to establish the identity of the objects. There is also a lack of independently confirmed data on their size, distance from the aircraft, or actual altitude. Without these measurements, it is difficult to judge their position and movement based solely on video footage.

https://ua-stena.info/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/plane.mp4

Objects that appear close to the aircraft in a short video may be much further away than they appear. Perspective, camera movement, and the lack of nearby landmarks can complicate the interpretation of aerial photography.

Currently, there is insufficient confirmed information to identify the objects or explain their appearance. The footage also does not allow us to determine whether they were hot air balloons, atmospheric phenomena, or something less well-known.

Nevertheless, the circumstances described make this video worthy of study. If the objects were indeed captured while flying at such an altitude, the video raises an intriguing question about what was in the aircraft’s field of view.

Earlier, reports surfaced of a mysterious UFO that nearly collided with the International Space Station. Video taken directly from the SpaceX Dragon spacecraft captured the astonishing approach in orbit.
